verdict.rationale: Adyen documents platform-side transaction rules that automatically approve or decline authorizations that don't meet business requirements, so enforcement without your own code is evidenced. The pack does not show that these rules support amount caps over daily, monthly or all-time windows, transaction-count velocity, or per-cardholder versus per-card scoping. Missing for 10: documented amount limits with daily/monthly/lifetime windows, transaction-count velocity rules, per-card and per-cardholder (account holder) rule scoping, Customer Area/ops UI for configuring limits, independent corroboration.
